rationale: Structural analysis confirms the pipeline labels: target derivative dv_dt, single independent variable t, three dynamic states (x, v, viscoelastic_damping_force), and nine fixed parameters. Because the contract types this as an ODE system, I do not re-derive the state RHS; I inherit it verbatim and only pick sampling, parameters, noise, and sanity checks. Mass and stiffness scales are set to O(1) SI-flavoured values so the natural period ~2π sqrt(m/k_lin)≈6.3 s (further shortened by hardening) is comfortably resolved by 300 points over [0,30] s (several damped cycles). limiting_extension=1.2 m sits just above the maximum |x|=1.0 set by the IC, per the evolution-step hint that it must exceed max|x|, and this places the operating point close to the finite-extensibility lock-up so its (x/L)^8/(1-(x/L)^2) factor is order 1 near the turning points. finite_extensibility_stiffness=10 N/m was chosen so the new term contributes ~7 m/s^2 to dv/dt at x=1, comparable to and slightly dominant over the polynomial hardening stack, matching the physical scenario of an approach-to-lockup nonlinearity. damping_coefficient=0.2, damping_relaxation_time=2 s give a mild, physically reasonable viscoelastic decay so multiple cycles are observed. Excitation check on the full ODE system shows the new mechanism moves dv/dt by 127*sigma, well above the k=5 threshold.
